$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 Test 3 — Windows ship-readiness acceptance. Small (2-run) plan that validates v1.5.7 runs cleanly on Windows. Capable models (opus + sonnet) on both channels (pip + npm). pool=1 means runs go SEQUENTIAL, not concurrent — validates that the harness works on Windows under the simplest scheduling constraints. Operator-side: install the QPB wheel via pipx on Windows (`pipx install <path-to-wheel>`); the harness's pip-local-wheel channel then invokes the QPB CLI from pipx's isolated venv. The harness internally uses pip / pip3 (whatever resolves on PATH) for the in-target install of the QPB shim.

runs.description: Windows opus + pip-local-wheel: top-tier claude on the pip channel. Sequential pool=1 ensures this finishes before row 2 starts. Validates that v1.5.7 installs cleanly on Windows via pip and that the QPB Phase 0–6 pipeline runs end-to-end on the platform.

Windows sonnet + npm-local-tgz: mid-tier claude on the npm channel. Validates that 150's npx --yes fix works on Windows (where the Ok-to-proceed prompt would have the same TTY-blocking effect as on Mac). Sequential pool=1 — runs after row 1 completes.
